description: We are "Northern Farmers' Future", farmers and innovators from Northern Uganda, where erratic rain, droughts and post-harvest losses hit smallholder farmers hard.Vision: climatesmart, food-secure farming communities. Mission: turn NASA rainfall, soil moisture and temperature data into simple planting and storage advice for farmers. Goals: better yields, less crop loss, stronger climate resilience. We bring farming and building skills; we need coders,  software developers, and many more.Join us!
